about_the_game:
Over Engineered is an idle strategy game that encourages construction of complex machines. Using limited space, money, and power; you must build complex contraptions to bring a ball from its spawn, to its goal. The longer each ball takes, the more money you make in return.

Machine Parts:

Unlock new machine parts to build more complex contraptions. Give each item a whirl and see what new creations you can bring into your game.

Unlock Balls:

Unlock new balls with various properties that can shift the style of your gameplay. Each gives a new multiplier to help continue your need for complexity.

Manage Power:

Generate and disperse power to build more sophisticate contraptions. The more complex an item is, the more power an item will take.

Idle Efficiency:

Over-Engineered was designed with the principle that time is a valuable resource; both in-game, and out of it. As a product, many multitasking modes were implemented to allow for maximum time efficiency. This includes the ability to adjust the screen size at will, as well as a fully docked version that keeps them in the game loop while simultaneously giving their screen back.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Design elaborate contraptions, where the longer a ball takes, the better. Inspired by Rube Goldberg machines, you’ll soon craft sprawling machines where complexity is your goal. Get ready to overtake your screen with over-engineered chaos.
